'''Ami Koshimizu''' (Japanese: '''小清水亜美''' ''Koshimizu Ami'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Koshimizu was born on February 15, 1986, in {{wp|Kokubunji, Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She first provided her voice for {{OBP|Mariah|AG148}}, a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{aniseries|RS}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. She then returned during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced recurring character [[Nina]]. Koshimizu was affiliated with {{wp|Production Baobab}} until 2011, and is currently affiliated with Axlone.
